premises.text: In high-inflation emerging markets most people are unbanked and lack credit, making common online credit payments impossible
premises.evidence_span: most of the population in this country is unbanked and also doesn't have access to credit

premises.text: Ripio Credit lets users pay online on installments in local currency at Ripio merchants and Bitcoin-accepting merchants worldwide
premises.evidence_span: our users can pay online on installments in local currency in any of our merchants or the hundreds of thousands of merchants that accept Bitcoin payments worldwide

premises.text: Machine learning identity verification and fraud scoring from ID photos, social data, and external sources underwrites credit approval
premises.evidence_span: processed by our back end using machine learning techniques, together with the information that the user provided, the social data, also pulling some external sources

premises.text: Users repay via monthly statements using a bank account or cash at thousands of partner locations such as Pago Fácil, Boleto, and Oxxo
premises.evidence_span: they can use any of the 16,000 merchant locations that we have partnered with, where they can go and pay in cash

value.text: Unbanked emerging-market consumers can shop online on affordable local-currency installments
value.evidence_span: pay on credit on affordable installments in local currency

Ripio Credit, which is our solution to this problem
